attack_surface.boundary: the local machine: what is written to and read from disk, and what is accepted from the index and refs

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: links above the vault root are allowed (a symlinked home, /tmp)
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: sgit never follows, commits or writes through a symlink inside the working copy

mechanisms_implemented.does_not_guarantee: a plain copy of the key's text, a repacked .tgz, a zip with bytes prepended (TM-R34); a tracked .env stays tracked (TM-R09)
mechanisms_implemented.guarantees: commit and write refuse any zip holding a vault or signing key and any hard link to a .sg_vault/local file; the always-ignored set keeps .env*, .netrc and SSH private keys out

secrets_exposure.note: see the dossier for the exact functions; TM-R14/TM-R15 cover keys on argv, stdout and disk

risk_decision.rationale: KNOWN (TM-R34: the guard is a last resort by design); the size bound is new

vulnerabilities.title: _secret_entry fails open on BadZipFile / ValueError / RuntimeError and has no decompressed-size bound
What refuse_files skips (lstat error, non-regular, link component) is never committed unchecked

written_by: review/tools/security_json.py from review/ data (2026-10-11); no model in this tool
